name: Data Center Siting: Wattmere
subtitle: Site selection and course
shortDescription: Learn how data center sites are chosen, then score and compare regions on 64 factors: power, cooling, hazards, fibre and cost.
longDescription:
Learn how data center sites are chosen, then score and compare real regions.

Data Center Siting: Wattmere is an adaptive course and a professional workbench in one app, for developers, infrastructure investors, real estate and energy teams, consultants, economic developers and students. Learn the factors that decide a site, practise until they stick, then apply them to U.S. regions and your parcels. Offline, no account.

### Learn the Way a Coach Would Teach
82 course points, each with a concept card, a worked example and 8 or 9 original practice questions (662 in all). Practice adapts to you: it finds the points where you are weakest, picks questions at the right difficulty and links every answer back to the concept. A Today panel shows mastery and what to do next. Switch any time between the Syllabus view and the Real-World view, where three guided builds walk you through a complete siting decision in the real tools.

64 SITING FACTORS, EVERY ONE EXPLAINED
Power cost, time to power, grid reliability, dual feeds, substation capacity, bridging generation, carbon-free matching, free cooling, wet-bulb and extreme temperatures, water and closed-loop cooling, seismic, flood, wildfire, lightning, air quality, soil, hazard buffers, fibre paths, cloud on-ramps, subsea landings, taxes and equipment exemptions, permitting, community sentiment, land, expansion headroom, heavy-haul access and more. Hide any factor you do not need and the score updates at once.

### Six Workload Presets
AI training campus (200 MW to 2 GW), cloud and inference region, edge (1 to 20 MW, under 10 ms), colocation, enterprise and disaster recovery, each weighted differently. Change any weight and see exactly why a site ranks where it does.

### Compare, Map and Cost
Compare sites across 47 U.S. market regions. Explore cited public-data layers on an offline map. Model total cost of ownership, cooling fit, emissions and phased capacity with typeset formulas.

### Diligence and Field Mode
Work a due diligence checklist, keep a risk register, check a parcel against screening thresholds and capture GPS, photos and notes on a site visit. They stay on your device.

### Sensitivity, 3d and Reports
Stress power price, PUE, water and delays, orbit four 3D scenes, and export an executive PDF or CSV files.

### An Honest Note About Data and Content
Region values are indicative classes built from public sources, and version 1 covers the United States only. Substation headroom and utility queue positions are not public, so confirm power, permitting and costs with the utility, authorities and qualified professionals. The course is original decision-support education, not a licensed qualification, and Wattmere is not affiliated with any utility, agency, standards body or data provider. It gives no engineering, legal, financial or investment advice.
